dedupe_keys.name: instituto nacional de estatistica electricity datasets

description: Instituto Nacional de Estatística: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Nacional de Estatística. Coverage: Instituto Nacional de Estatística. The listing groups 150 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Pontos de carregamento (N.º); Tomadas (N.º) nos pontos de carregamento; Proporção de empresas das indústrias transformadoras com fatores compe; Quota da produção de energia elétrica (%) em centrais de cogeração. Formats seen: JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
